name: Jossith Yarra
keeps: the two hashes, and the disagreement between them
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: Argued for experiment and mathematics against argument from authority.
text: Jossith yarra of the turned key, keeps the book for the 3rd tranche, doors 20 to 28. Keeps the two hashes, and the disagreement between them. Reads Roger Bacon.
